Write a diff as a unified diff

Source: R/text.R
diff_unified.Rd

Writes the hunks of a diff in the unified format of GNU diff, which patch, git apply and patch_apply() read.

Usage

diff_unified(d, context = 3L, old_name = "old", new_name = "new")

Arguments

d

A zudiff object, from diff_vec() or diff_text().

context

The number of unchanged lines around each change.

old_name, new_name

The file names for the --- and +++ headers.

Value

One string: the unified diff, ending in a newline, or "" when the two inputs are identical.

Details

For a diff_text() result, each line is written as it is, and a last line without a newline is followed by \ No newline at end of file. For a diff_vec() result, each element is written with format() as one line.

Examples

d <- diff_text("a\nb\nc\n", "a\nx\nc\n")
cat(diff_unified(d, old_name = "a/file.txt", new_name = "b/file.txt"))
#> --- a/file.txt
#> +++ b/file.txt
#> @@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
#>  a
#> -b
#> +x
#>  c
